# v0.29.0

## Highlights

This release features 594 commits from 277 contributors (91 new)!

- **Model Runner V2 is now the default for all models** ( [#53183](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53183)), completing the rollout that began with pooling models ( [#48290](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/48290)). MRV2 also gained CUDA graph memory profiling for KV cache auto-sizing ( [#53306](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53306)), batch-sharded sampling that cuts per-step logits memory by 1/TP ( [#50465](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50465)), prompt embeds ( [#42963](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/42963)), `extract_hidden_states` speculation ( [#49811](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/49811)), padded FULL cudagraph dispatch for uniform decode under spec decode ( [#53407](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53407)), and DP-sync skipping before EAGLE/MTP draft prefill ( [#53694](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53694)). MRV1 remains in use for a few ROCm models and features MRV2 does not yet support.
- **New models**: Hy4-preview, Tencent's 770B/49B-active MoE with Gated DeepSeek Sparse Attention and native MTP ( [#54160](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54160)); Qwen3.8-Flash-Next with BF16/FP8/NVFP4 and MTP ( [#53896](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53896)); GraniteSWA and GraniteMoeSWA ( [#52706](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52706)); NemotronH\_Omni\_Reasoning\_V3 with MTP ( [#52929](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52929), [#53121](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53121)); Kimi K3 NVFP4 checkpoints ( [#53132](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53132)).
- **Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek V4 performance**: fused MXFP4 top-k finalization in the K3 latent tail (about 5% E2E latency, [#53152](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53152)), K3 Mamba metadata preparation in one Triton launch (6.6-7.6x kernel speedup, [#52388](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52388)), tuned Hopper low-latency GEMM ( [#54088](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54088)) now also dispatched on SM100 ( [#53534](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53534)) and used for `eh_proj` (12.9-25.2% kernel speedup, [#53942](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53942)), GEMM-RS extended to GEMM-AR ( [#53053](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53053)), MLA gate merged into the QKV-A projection ( [#54015](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54015)), K3 DCP with DSpark ( [#52188](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52188)) and DCP partial prefix cache hits ( [#50493](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50493)); DeepSeek V4 shared experts fused into MegaMoE ( [#53040](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53040)), adaptive top-k width re-landed ( [#52823](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52823)), a native SwiGLU clamp kernel for Humming MoE ( [#53685](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53685)), and an opt-in FlashInfer `moe_ep` expert backend ( [#49636](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/49636)).
- **Speculative decoding**: per-request acceptance stats in OpenAI API responses via `--per-request-spec-decode-metrics` ( [#48915](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/48915)), adaptive verification extended to logprobs ( [#52242](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52242)), SM100 sparse MLA for GLM-5.2 ( [#52783](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52783)) and DeepSeek V4 on SM90 ( [#52795](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52795)), Qwen3-Omni DSpark drafts ( [#52560](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52560)), PLaMo3 EAGLE-3/DFlash ( [#54239](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54239)), and DFlash2 loading from speculators format ( [#53797](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53797)).
- **RL weight sync**: a new `sharded_rdt` P2P backend where each worker pulls only its TP/EP slice over NIXL or Ray Direct Transport ( [#43375](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/43375)), rank-local IPC weight updates ( [#52497](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52497)), sparse checkpoint-coordinate updates through native weight loaders ( [#50723](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50723), [#53751](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53751)), and routed expert loading for gpt-oss ( [#52209](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52209)).
- **Mamba prefix caching**: internal prefill checkpoints deliver a 9%-25% TTFT improvement ( [#52789](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52789)); `prefix_cache_retention_interval` is now a CLI argument defaulting to 0 ( [#52216](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52216)), with dense retention automatically restored for hybrid models using EAGLE/MTP ( [#55760](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/55760), [#55861](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/55861)).
- **New defaults**: FlashInfer all-reduce enabled by default for TP CUDA groups, opt out with `VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_FLASHINFER=0` ( [#52998](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52998)); prefix-cache `NONE_HASH` is deterministic by default so distributed KV cache users no longer need to pin `PYTHONHASHSEED` ( [#51875](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51875)); new `--max-num-queued-reqs` / `--max-num-queued-tokens` admission-control flags ( [#49445](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/49445)).
- **Breaking changes**: ten deprecated model architectures removed ( [#53608](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53608)); FlexOlmo, Olmo3 and Hunyuan V1/VL migrated to the Transformers modeling backend ( [#53615](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53615)); PyAV video decoder backend removed ( [#54231](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54231)); `python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server` deprecated in favor of `vllm serve` ( [#52131](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52131)); `VLLM_TEST_FORCE_FP8_MARLIN` ( [#52182](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52182)) and `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ASM_GEMM` ( [#53141](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53141)) removed.

## Model Support

- **New models**: Hy4-preview ( [#54160](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54160)), Qwen3.8-Flash-Next ( [#53896](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53896)), GraniteSWA and GraniteMoeSWA via the existing Granite implementation ( [#52706](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52706)), NemotronH\_Omni\_Reasoning\_V3 ( [#52929](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52929)) with MTP for Nemotron VL models ( [#53121](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53121)), bidirectional attention for DeepSeek-backbone embedding models ( [#52948](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52948)), FP8 ModernBERT ( [#53101](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53101)), and Kimi K3 NVFP4 checkpoints ( [#53132](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53132)).
- **Transformers modeling backend**: FlexOlmo, Olmo3 and Hunyuan V1/VL migrated off native implementations ( [#53615](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53615)), multimodal path hardened ( [#51827](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51827)), and `RMSNormFuser.fuse` performance fixed ( [#52766](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52766)).
- **Weight loading**: weight tying now inspects the checkpoint so a real `lm_head` is loaded even when the config claims tied embeddings ( [#51665](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51665), [#53170](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53170)).
- **LoRA**: DeepSeek V4 ( [#53361](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53361)), Qwen3-Omni multimodal LoRA ( [#52786](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52786), [#53557](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53557)), tower/connector LoRA for LLaVA-NeXT ( [#49788](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/49788)) and LFM2-VL ( [#51498](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51498)), plus fixes for Muse-Glimmer ( [#53513](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53513)), Qwen3.5 embedding modules ( [#48850](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/48850)), partial LoRA on Qwen3.5/3.6 GatedDeltaNet ( [#47640](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/47640)), int32 overflow in punica kernels at long context ( [#53034](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53034)), false target matches on unsupported module types ( [#52313](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52313)), and base-layer/routed-expert prefix ordering ( [#52552](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52552)).
- **Multimodal performance**: ViT full CUDA graph for Idefics3 and SmolVLM ( [#47625](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/47625)), packed encoder attention for Pixtral ( [#52185](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52185)), fused Kimi vision Q/K RoPE kernel ( [#50400](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50400)), Dots3 NOTE runtime ( [#53517](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53517)) and Omni encoder optimizations ( [#53460](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53460)), MM tensors no longer broadcast to workers for prefix-cache-covered items ( [#52041](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52041)), redundant placeholder scans skipped ( [#52925](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52925)), common token sequences cached ( [#53560](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53560)), async media resolved concurrently across modalities ( [#54537](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54537)), and H2D copies pinned to avoid stream stalls ( [#53412](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53412), [#54292](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54292), [#54299](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54299)).
- **Multimodal inputs**: video embeds accepted by the Python frontend ( [#54242](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54242)), modality-scoped `mm_processor_kwargs` honored ( [#53808](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53808)), Qwen3-VL profiling honors `cap_pixels_per_frame` ( [#54380](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54380)), video frame sampling respects MP4 edit-list trims ( [#48608](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/48608)), oversized items skip the MM processor cache instead of crashing ( [#53016](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53016)), encoder cache entries survive until their last use ( [#54284](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54284)), and repeated multimodal requests with the SHM cache no longer terminate the engine ( [#54994](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54994)).
- **Correctness**: PaliGemma stale image scaling removed ( [#52692](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52692)), Mistral3 placeholder grid with processor size overrides ( [#52874](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52874)), MiniCPM-o on Transformers v5 ( [#54501](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54501)), JinaVL cache order ( [#53553](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53553)), mixed CLIP/SigLIP pooling batches ( [#53165](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53165)), XD-RoPE models on prefix-cache hits ( [#53456](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53456)), Qwen3-Omni audio encoder with non-divisible TP ( [#50858](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50858)), GLM-5.2 no longer uses dense MHA ( [#52512](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52512)), Moondream3 MoE all-reduce ( [#54152](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54152)), deepseek-vl2 config defaults ( [#51302](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51302)), HY-V3 compressed-tensors ignore matching ( [#48682](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/48682)), MiniMax-M3 FP8 query allocation under CUDA graph replay ( [#51203](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51203)), and GraniteMoeHybrid quantized expert loading ( [#54052](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54052)).

## Engine Core

- **Model Runner V2**: default for all models ( [#53183](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53183)) and pooling models ( [#48290](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/48290)), CUDA graph memory reservation ( [#53306](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53306)), batch-sharded sampling ( [#50465](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50465)), prompt embeds ( [#42963](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/42963)), `extract_hidden_states` ( [#49811](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/49811)), padded FULL cudagraph dispatch ( [#53407](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53407)), DP-sync skipping for drafts ( [#53694](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53694)), decoupled draft/target gumbel noise streams ( [#54282](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54282)), encoder-only path split out ( [#53176](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53176)), and memory released correctly on shutdown and sleep ( [#53508](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53508), [#54246](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54246), [#54162](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54162), [#53955](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53955), [#53682](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53682)).
- **Speculative decoding**: per-request acceptance stats ( [#48915](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/48915)), adaptive verification with logprobs ( [#52242](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52242)), on SM100 sparse MLA ( [#52783](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52783)) and DSv4 + SM90 ( [#52795](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52795)), varlen trtllm-gen decode ( [#52157](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52157)), FlashInfer MLA for DSpark drafting under DCP ( [#54277](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54277)), fused GDN MTP for all Qwen head ratios ( [#52539](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52539)), widest uniform decode batch captured by default ( [#50488](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50488)) with memory-safe graph sizes ( [#54418](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54418)), and fixes for short\_conv/LFM2 targets ( [#50272](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50272)), speculators-format config overrides ( [#42376](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/42376)), DFlash draft RoPE layout ( [#54373](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54373)), draft models with a different GQA ratio ( [#53002](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53002)), draft models with a larger hidden size under TP ( [#52193](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52193)), DSpark backend inheritance scoped to DeepSeek V4 ( [#52809](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52809)), generic `DSparkDraftModel` configs for Qwen3 ( [#52197](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52197)), and Gemma4 MTP under CUDA graphs ( [#53884](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53884)).
- **Prefix caching & scheduling**: Mamba internal prefill checkpoints ( [#52789](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52789)), `prefix_cache_retention_interval` argument ( [#52216](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52216), [#55760](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/55760), [#55861](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/55861)), deterministic `NONE_HASH` ( [#51875](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51875)), queue admission control ( [#49445](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/49445)), KV null block reserved when validating `max_model_len` ( [#47272](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/47272)), spec decode no longer padded up to `max_model_len` ( [#53962](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53962)), and negative external block allocation prevented ( [#52707](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52707)).

- Decoder prompt-length validation enforced for processors that skip the check ( [#46588](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/46588)); PyNvVideoCodec decoder slot limit bypass fixed ( [#52126](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52126)).
- `api_key` and `hf_token` redacted from startup logs, compile cache factors, and the Rust frontend launch log ( [#52523](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52523), [#53625](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53625), [#53738](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53738)).

## Breaking Changes & Deprecations

- Ten deprecated architectures removed: Arctic, Chameleon, Cheers, Fairseq2Llama, FireRedLID, GritLM, HCXVision, MPT, the `RWForCausalLM` and `StableLMEpochForCausalLM` aliases, and `PrithviGeoSpatialMAE` (superseded by `Terratorch`) ( [#53608](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53608)).
- FlexOlmo, Olmo3, Hunyuan V1 and Hunyuan VL are now served through the Transformers modeling backend ( [#53615](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53615)).
- PyAV video decoder backend removed; use OpenCV or Torchcodec ( [#54231](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54231)).
- `python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server` is deprecated; use `vllm serve` ( [#52131](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52131)).
- Model Runner V2 is the default runner for all models ( [#53183](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53183)).
- `prefix_cache_retention_interval` default changed from dense to 0 for SWA/SSM models; the env var is deprecated in favor of the argument ( [#52216](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52216)).
- FlashInfer all-reduce enabled by default ( [#52998](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52998)).
- `VLLM_TEST_FORCE_FP8_MARLIN` removed in favor of `--linear-backend` / `--moe-backend` ( [#52182](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52182)); `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ASM_GEMM` removed ( [#53141](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53141)); dead `--attention-config.use_prefill_decode_attention` removed ( [#52557](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52557)); other long-deprecated parameters cleaned up ( [#53559](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53559)).
